title: Hourly GOP Auto-Dig:RNC receipts and location semantics
summary: Dataset-first randomized GOP pass records distinct public mailing and principal-place-of-business predicates for the RNC and advances the queued affiliated-transfer/other-receipts target with current FEC summary totals.

data.research_question: What defensible public RNC location semantics can be added while advancing the queued affiliated-transfer/other-receipts target, and has current news materially changed that evidence graph?
data.method: Full dataset/topic pool reuse from the latest merged reproducible hourly enumeration; remove recent successful selections and apply deterministic random.Random seed selection; select within the explicit queued GOP target frontier; review current FEC committee summary and RNC-hosted legal filing; current-news search; create typed packet and bounded recursive target.
classification_rules: Dataset-stage selection is approximately uniform after recent-run diversity exclusions.
RNC mailing address and principal place of business are separate predicates even when the street address matches.
FEC summary categories do not establish source committees, donors, vendors, control, coordination, or transaction-level attribution.
Current-news material is ingested only when it changes the selected target's entity, location, transaction, relation, correction, or conflict evidence.

findings.selection_algorithm: sorted full pool -> remove recent successful dataset/topic selections -> random.Random(seed).choice; continue same RNG for stage-two explicit queued-target choice

findings.result: FEC currently lists 310 First Street SE, Washington, DC 20003 as the RNC mailing address; an RNC-hosted federal complaint identifies the same address as its principal place of business. The predicates remain separate.
FEC coverage through June 30, 2026 reports $30,174,683.21 in transfers from affiliated committees and $86,999,676.47 in other receipts; transaction-level source resolution remains unresolved.

findings.scope: Current web/news search through 2026-08-19 for RNC/Republican National Committee developments relevant to location or receipt-source resolution.
findings.result: Recent reporting concerned primary-election outcomes and campaign activity, not a new RNC location designation or itemized explanation of the selected FEC receipt categories. No filler news document was ingested.
